## Slack Kudos and Recognition

Peer recognition system with leaderboard.

**Kudos Flow:**
1. `/kudos @user Great work on the API!`
2. Parse recipient and reason
3. Post formatted kudos to #recognition
4. Track in Google Sheets leaderboard

**Monthly Summary:**
1. 1st of month at 10AM
2. Read leaderboard data
3. Compile top recognized people
4. Post summary to #recognition
